description: The fact-check-pass skill dispatches fact-checker to verify each claim marker in a chapter against the evidence log and surface unverified claims.

cases.given: fact-check-pass is invoked on a chapter containing [UNVERIFIED] markers and uncovered claims
cases.expect: fact-checker agent is dispatched to review each claim and produce a verification report with flagged items

cases.given: fact-check-pass is invoked on a chapter where all claims resolve to EV- entries
cases.expect: fact-checker agent is dispatched and returns a clean verification report with no flags
